node: Tariff, sanctions, customs, and country-of-origin compliance stack
summary: Expanded the universe around the compliance-infrastructure layer rather than tariff-targeted manufacturers. Best-fit US-listed exposures are a mix of global trade software/content, customs brokerage, and third-party inspection/audit providers. The underfollowed lane is more attractive for mapping than for immediate conclusion: Descartes has the clearest software/data exposure; UL Solutions is an adjacent inspection and supply-chain-assurance chokepoint; Forward Air is a small-cap speculative logistics/customs-brokerage exception with weaker purity. Expeditors is included as a reference anchor because customs brokerage is material to its business and its filings explicitly flag tariff complexity and trade actions.
